title: Dagu 1.23.0 before 2.0.0 defaults auth.mode to none, allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute… (CVE-2026-126752)
description: Dagu versions from 1.23.0 up to but not including 2.0.0 have a default authentication mode set to none. This misconfiguration allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary operating system commands via the /api/v2/dag-runs endpoint by sending a specially crafted POST request. The vulnerability enables remote code execution without any authentication. Evidence of exploitation was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on March 11, 2026. The vulnerability has a critical CVSS score of 9.8.
